<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>Tiny: Left Unsupervised | Illustrated Stage 1 Trial</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;--gold:#f6c774;--pink:#e16b9a;--night:#1b142a;--cream:#fff1d9}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;margin:0;background:#0b0911;color:#ffead5;touch-action:manipulation}
body{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#game{position:relative;width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh * 16 / 9));height:min(100dvh,calc(100vw * 9 / 16));aspect-ratio:16/9;border:clamp(2px,.4vw,6px) solid #b88558;border-radius:clamp(11px,1.7vw,23px);overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(#281525,#1c132c);box-shadow:0 0 40px #000}
#game:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border:2px solid #f6ce8744;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:30}
#scene{position:absolute;inset:9.5% 0 18.8%;background-image:url(data:image/webp;base64,);background-size:cover;background-position:center 48%;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
#scene:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#180c2011,transparent 62%,#180c201b),linear-gradient(0deg,#28102422,transparent 25%);pointer-events:none}
#noosh{position:absolute;width:31%;height:115%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;right:2.5%;bottom:-22%;filter:drop-shadow(0 9px 8px #1c08248b);z-index:3;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.2,1),opacity .65s;transform-origin:60% 75%}
#noosh.offstage{transform:translateX(160%) rotate(9deg);opacity:0}
#peek{position:absolute;z-index:7;width:23%;height:68%;right:-24%;top:5%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1);filter:drop-shadow(-4px 6px 9px #120a17bc);pointer-events:none}
#peek.visible{transform:translateX(-102%)}
#peek.warning{transform:translateX(-45%) rotate(-2deg)}
#hud{position:absolute;z-index:15;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:9.8%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.15%;padding:0 1.25%;background:#170d21ed;border-bottom:2px solid #b9895c;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #130a20a0}
#brand{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(9px,1.35vw,22px);white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000}
.pill{border:1px solid #bd8f6c;border-radius:100px;padding:.42em .8em;white-space:nowrap;background:#2c172e;color:#ffe5cf;font-size:clamp(8px,1.18vw,17px);font-weight:900}
#energyTrack{height:8px;min-width:36px;flex:1;border:1px solid #cb9d75;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;background:#1f122b}
#energyBar{height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e35c96,#ffb7d3);transition:width .2s}
#energyText{font-size:clamp(9px,1.23vw,17px);font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}
.topIcon{font-size:clamp(13px,1.9vw,23px);background:#312039;border:1px solid #a57f7b;border-radius:10px;color:#fff3db;cursor:pointer;min-width:5%;height:76%;display:grid;place-items:center}
.topIcon:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #95e8d4;outline-offset:2px}
#chapter{position:absolute;top:1.5%;left:1.7%;z-index:5;font-size:clamp(9px,1.2vw,15px);font-weight:900;background:#221329dc;padding:.35em .8em;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #d3a26e}
#status{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);top:3%;z-index:6;display:none;background:#233d34e8;border:1px solid #b7eacd;border-radius:12px;padding:.35em 1em;font-size:clamp(10px,1.65vw,23px);font-weight:1000;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #1510237a}
#status.warn{background:#6a4026; color:#ffe3b1}
#status.watch{background:#762942;color:#fff3eb;border-color:#ff9d9e;animation:shake .3s ease-in-out 2}
#speech{position:absolute;z-index:8;top:12%;right:21%;max-width:53%;background:#fff6e8;color:#3b2836;border:3px solid #d6ac70;padding:1.1% 2%;border-radius:clamp(12px,2vw,26px);text-align:center;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #3f1e30aa,0 0 14px #0003;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(10px,1.78vw,27px);line-height:1.2;font-weight:800;transition:opacity .18s}
#speech.tiny{left:19%;right:auto;top:15%;max-width:55%}
#speech:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-17px;right:12%;border-top:17px solid #d6ac70;border-left:15px solid transparent}
#speech.tiny:after{left:13%;right:auto}
#speech.hidden{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#progressBar{position:absolute;left:2%;bottom:4%;width:26%;height:9px;border-radius:10px;background:#1d1230d1;border:1px solid #b8875b;z-index:8;overflow:hidden;display:none}
#progressBar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffacd5,#f4b45a);transition:width .25s}
#progressText{position:absolute;left:2%;bottom:8%;color:#fff6e5;background:#23182cdd;border-radius:8px;padding:.32em .6em;font-size:clamp(9px,1.25vw,17px);font-weight:900;z-index:8;display:none}
#spark{position:absolute;z-index:10;font-size:clamp(34px,7vw,95px);top:42%;left:51%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 1px 16px #ffcb87}
#spark.show{animation:pop .72s ease-out}
#powers{position:absolute;z-index:12;left:1.6%;bottom:21.4%;display:flex;gap:.7%;width:51%}
.power{padding:.55em .65em;border:1px solid #e6b689;border-bottom-width:3px;border-radius:14px;background:#251629e8;color:#f9ebdf;font-size:clamp(8px,1.08vw,15px);font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 7px #0008}
.power:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}
#bottom{position:absolute;z-index:14;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:19%;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#221227f5,#1a1329fa);border-top:3px solid #d7a26a;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2%;padding:1.2% 1.8%;box-shadow:0 -4px 13px #271427bb}
#bottomCopy{flex:1;min-width:0}
#speaker{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;color:#f6c577;font-size:clamp(14px,2vw,27px)}
#story{font-size:clamp(9px,1.32vw,18px);line-height:1.28;max-width:100%;margin-top:.15em;color:#fff0d8}
#actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;max-width:53%}
.btn{background:linear-gradient(#ffb3ca,#d84c90 37%,#a92d68);border:2px solid #f5c97e;border-bottom:5px solid #7c2c51;border-radius:17px;padding:.6em 1em;color:#fff3e5;font-size:clamp(10px,1.6vw,20px);font-weight:1000;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #6b2446;box-shadow:0 3px 7px #0007;cursor:pointer;min-width:clamp(80px,12vw,165px)}
.btn.secondary{background:linear-gradient(#534263,#2e243d);border-color:#ad8972}
#help{position:absolute;z-index:25;inset:9% 10% 18%;background:#190f25ed;border:2px solid #e9ba7c;border-radius:20px;padding:3%;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 0 0 999px #130a1cbb}
#help h2{color:#ffe0a0;font-size:clamp(19px,3vw,38px);margin:.25em 0}#help p{max-width:620px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.7vw,23px);line-height:1.4}#help .btn{margin-top:1rem}
#portrait{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:-5%;width:18%;height:44%;object-fit:contain;opacity:.85;pointer-events:none;z-index:4;display:none}
#patience{position:absolute;right:2%;bottom:9%;z-index:8;display:none;color:#fff1db;font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,16px);font-weight:900}
#patienceBar{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;border:1px solid #ffe09e;border-radius:9px;background:#32172c;width:clamp(60px,11vw,146px);height:10px;margin-left:6px;overflow:hidden}
#patienceBar i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ed7f91,#f6d687);transition:width .4s}
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:20;left:50%;top:67%;transform:translateX(-50%);border:1px solid #e8c390;background:#1e162be8;color:#fff1db;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;padding:7px 16px;display:none;white-space:nowrap;max-width:96%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.35vw,18px)}
@keyframes pop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-65%) scale(.4)}25%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.25)}80%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-100%) scale(.8)}}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}25%{transform:translateX(calc(-50% + 4px))}75%{transform:translateX(calc(-50% - 4px))}}
@media(max-width:700px){#powers{bottom:22%;left:1%;width:59%}.power{padding:.4em .4em;border-radius:9px}#speech{top:14%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.8vw,14px)}#noosh{height:120%;bottom:-22%}#bottom{height:20%}#scene{bottom:20%}#actions{max-width:50%}.pill{padding:.3em .45em}#brand{font-size:9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation-duration:.001s!important;transition-duration:.001s!important}}
</style></head>
<body><main id="game" aria-label="Stage 1 illustrated game preview">
<header id="hud"><span id="brand">🎀 TINY LEFT UNSUPERVISED</span><span class="pill">STAGE 1</span><span class="pill">CHAOS <span id="chaos">0</span></span><span id="energyText">⚡ <b id="energy">0</b>/100</span><span id="energyTrack"><i id="energyBar"></i></span><button class="topIcon" id="sound" title="Toggle sound" aria-label="Toggle sound">♫</button><button class="topIcon" id="full" title="Fullscreen" aria-label="Fullscreen">⛶</button></header>
<section id="scene"><div id="chapter">THE THRONE INCIDENT</div><img id="noosh" alt="Illustrated Noosh, a white dog with a natural brown nose birthmark" src="data:image/webp;base64," /><img id="peek" alt="Noosh peeking back" src="data:image/webp;base64," /><div id="status" role="status"></div><div id="speech">Noosh: Tiny. I am leaving for FIVE minutes. Please behave.</div><div id="progressText">THRONE INSPECTIONS: 0 / 5</div><div id="progressBar"><i></i></div><div id="patience">Noosh's patience <span id="patienceBar"><i></i></span></div><div id="spark">💖</div><div id="toast"></div></section>
<div id="powers"><button class="power" id="puppy">🥺 Puppy Eyes 30</button><button class="power" id="raccoons">🦝 Raccoons 60</button><button class="power" id="rage">🍗 Nuggie Rage 100</button></div>
<footer id="bottom"><div id="bottomCopy"><div id="speaker">NOOSH</div><div id="story">Tiny. I am leaving for FIVE minutes. Please behave.</div></div><div id="actions"><button id="primary" class="btn">START THE CHAOS ▶</button><button id="extra" class="btn secondary" hidden>REPLAY</button></div></footer>
<section id="help" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Quick how to"><h2>👀 How to Play</h2><p><b>Wait for Noosh to look away.</b> Tap LICK to inspect the throne. When his ears return, freeze and do not tap. Five successful licks complete the stage. If you're caught, the story continues.</p><button class="btn" id="gotit">GOT IT • LET'S PLAY ▶</button></section>
</main><script>
(function(){'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
const noosh=$('noosh'), peek=$('peek'), status=$('status'), powerButtons=['puppy','raccoons','rage'];
const state={phase:'intro',licks:0,chaos:0,energy:0,patience:100,nextAt:0,watch:'away',watchUntil:0,lockedUntil:0,freezeUntil:0,rage:false,paused:false,pauseTime:0,sound:false,last:0,since:0,firstTime:true};
let audioCtx=null,raf=0,toastTimeout=0,sparkTimeout=0;
function beep(freq=510,dur=.11,type='sine'){
 if(!state.sound)return;try{audioCtx ||= new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();let osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();osc.type=type;osc.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.value=.048;osc.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);osc.start();g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audioCtx.currentTime+dur);osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur);}catch(e){}
}
function line(name,msg){$('speaker').textContent=name.toUpperCase();$('story').textContent=msg;$('speech').textContent=name+': '+msg;$('speech').className=name.toLowerCase()==='tiny'?'tiny':'';}
function pop(s='💖'){const el=$('spark');el.textContent=s;el.classList.remove('show');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(sparkTimeout);sparkTimeout=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),760)}
function toast(msg){const el=$('toast');el.textContent=msg;el.style.display='block';clearTimeout(toastTimeout);toastTimeout=setTimeout(()=>{el.style.display='none'},1750)}
function setPhase(p){state.phase=p;document.body.dataset.phase=p}
function update(){
 $('chaos').textContent=state.chaos.toLocaleString();$('energy').textContent=Math.floor(state.energy);$('energyBar').style.width=state.energy+'%';
 $('progressText').textContent='THRONE INSPECTIONS: '+state.licks+' / 5';$('progressBar').firstElementChild.style.width=state.licks/5*100+'%';
 $('patienceBar').firstElementChild.style.width=state.patience+'%';
 $('progressText').style.display=state.phase==='stealth'?'block':'none';$('progressBar').style.display=state.phase==='stealth'?'block':'none';$('patience').style.display=state.phase==='stealth'?'block':'none';
 for(const [idx,key] of powerButtons.entries()){$(key).disabled=state.phase!=='stealth'||state.energy<[30,60,100][idx]}
}
function showStatus(text,kind){status.style.display='block';status.textContent=text;status.className=kind||''}
function displayAction(label,fn,extra){const p=$('primary');p.textContent=label;p.onclick=fn;p.hidden=false;$('extra').hidden=!extra;if(extra){$('extra').textContent='REPLAY';$('extra').onclick=reset}}
function begin(){setPhase('how');$('help').style.display='flex';noosh.classList.remove('offstage');$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');update()}
function start(){
 $('help').style.display='none';setPhase('stealth');state.licks=0;state.chaos=0;state.energy=0;state.patience=100;state.watch='away';state.watchUntil=0;state.freezeUntil=0;state.rage=false;state.lockedUntil=performance.now()+1200;state.nextAt=performance.now()+rnd(4200,6200);state.paused=false;
 noosh.classList.add('offstage');peek.classList.remove('visible','warning');$('speech').classList.add('hidden');
 showStatus('✅ NOOSH IS LOOKING AWAY','');line('Tiny','Five whole minutes? That sounds like an opportunity.');displayAction('👅 LICK THE THRONE',lick);update();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
function reset(){
 cancelAnimationFrame(raf);setPhase('intro');state.licks=0;state.chaos=0;state.energy=0;state.patience=100;state.watch='away';state.rage=false;state.freezeUntil=0;state.paused=false;
 noosh.classList.remove('offstage');peek.classList.remove('visible','warning');$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');showStatus('', '');status.style.display='none';line('Noosh','Tiny. I am leaving for FIVE minutes. Please behave.');displayAction('START THE CHAOS ▶',begin);update();
}
function tick(t){
 if(state.phase!=='stealth'||state.paused)return;
 if(state.watch==='away'&&t>=state.nextAt){state.watch='warning';state.watchUntil=t+620;peek.classList.add('warning');showStatus('⚠️ EARS INCOMING','warn');beep(280,.12,'triangle')}
 else if(state.watch==='warning'&&t>=state.watchUntil){state.watch='watching';state.watchUntil=t+rnd(1200,2050);peek.classList.remove('warning');peek.classList.add('visible');showStatus('👀 NOOSH IS WATCHING','watch');beep(160,.15,'sawtooth')}
 else if(state.watch==='watching'&&t>=state.watchUntil){state.watch='away';state.nextAt=t+rnd(2300,5400);peek.classList.remove('visible');showStatus('✅ NOOSH IS LOOKING AWAY','');}
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)
}
function lick(){
 if(state.phase!=='stealth')return;const t=performance.now();if(t<state.lockedUntil)return;
 state.lockedUntil=t+240;
 const safe=(state.watch==='away'||t<state.freezeUntil);
 if(safe){state.licks++;state.chaos+=state.rage?550:270;state.energy=Math.min(100,state.energy+24);state.rage=false;
 line('Tiny', ['A perfectly normal royal inspection.','It is technically quality control.','Nobody can prove anything.','The throne has excellent craftsmanship.','Anyway... my work here is done.'][Math.min(state.licks-1,4)]);pop('💖');toast('✨ PERFECTLY STEALTHY! +CHAOS');beep(740,.09);setTimeout(()=>beep(950,.11),90);
 if(state.licks>=5){finish()} }
 else{state.patience=Math.max(8,state.patience-17);state.chaos=Math.max(0,state.chaos-60);line('Noosh','I CAN SEE YOU. What exactly are you doing?!');pop('💥');toast('CAUGHT! A VERY OFFICIAL REPRIMAND');beep(200,.19,'square');state.lockedUntil=t+500;}
 update()
}
function usePower(kind){
 if(state.phase!=='stealth')return;
 const cost={puppy:30,raccoons:60,rage:100}[kind];if(state.energy<cost)return;
 state.energy-=cost;
 if(kind==='puppy'){state.freezeUntil=performance.now()+2400;toast('🥺 Puppy Eyes: 2.4 seconds of mercy');pop('🥺')}
 if(kind==='raccoons'){state.watch='away';state.nextAt=performance.now()+4600;peek.classList.remove('visible','warning');showStatus('🦝 NOOSH IS DISTRACTED','');toast('🦝 Tiny deployed a distraction');pop('🦝')}
 if(kind==='rage'){state.rage=true;toast('🍗 NEXT LICK GETS DOUBLE CHAOS');pop('🍗')}
 update()
}
function finish(){setPhase('complete');cancelAnimationFrame(raf);peek.classList.remove('visible','warning');noosh.classList.remove('offstage');showStatus('🏆 THE THRONE HAS BEEN INSPECTED','');
 $('speech').classList.remove('hidden');line('Noosh','WHY IS THE THRONE SPARKLING?');state.chaos+=500;pop('👑');beep(900,.2);displayAction('CONTINUE STORY ▸',()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_STAGE_DONE',stage:1,score:state.chaos,energy:state.energy,meta:{licks:state.licks,patience:state.patience}},'*'),true);update();}
for(const b of powerButtons)$(b).addEventListener('click',()=>usePower(b));
$('gotit').addEventListener('click',start);
$('sound').onclick=()=>{state.sound=!state.sound;$('sound').textContent=state.sound?'♫':'♪̸';beep()};
$('full').onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN'},'*');
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.code==='Space'||e.code==='Enter')&&state.phase==='stealth'){e.preventDefault();lick()}else if(e.key==='Escape'&&$('help').style.display==='flex')$('help').style.display='none'});
reset();
})();
</script></body></html>
